proposed_from.topic: Deletion-rank equilibrium-effect frontier for source-minimal cyclic latent LiNG models. Given a normalized full-row-rank overcomplete ICA representation X=C epsilon with independent moment-determinate non-Gaussian sources and no zero or proportional columns, range over every latent cyclic SCM completion with exactly those source directions, zero structural diagonal, invertible observational and postintervention systems, and no stability assumption. For ordered observed x!=y, prove the sharp equilibrium-effect set is {C_yj/C_xj: C_xj!=0 and rank(C_{-x,-j})=p-1}; construct a full same-law completion for every admissible j, characterize identification iff the set is a singleton, return two exact SCMs otherwise, and certify all values in O(n^4) arithmetic operations. For iid samples on a common-cumulant-order subclass with fixed moment, tensor-separation, minor, and denominator margins, derive the OICA inverse and simultaneous confidence union with uniform coverage and root-N Hausdorff uncertainty. Use Dai et al. 2026 and Tramontano et al. as anchors and the 14-stock HSI equivalence class as the consumer; graphical irreducibility without source minimality is explicitly excluded. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: Algebra gives the hard-intervention effect as a mixing-column ratio. A deletion-rank/cofactor argument plus one latent-row shear constructs every admissible completion, yielding the exact finite set and an O(n^4) all-witness algorithm; 248 rational witnesses across 24 matrices were checked. A common-order lifted-cumulant tensor pencil gives an explicit local inverse and finite-sample simultaneous coverage. Duplicate source directions, deletion-rank jumps, vanishing treatment loadings, stability restrictions, multi-effect set diameter, and nearby 2024-2026 literature were stress-tested; the larger graphically irreducible fiber fails. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: The mathematical theorem spine is complete on the stated separated iid class, but using the HSI illustration requires a defensible dependent-time-series sampling model and an informative empirical separation certificate; source-specific multi-order cumulant adaptation remains outside scope. EARLY KILL TEST: Reproduce the row-shear and perfect-matching constructions on rational p<=4,n<=6 instances and challenge the tensor inverse near every declared margin; any failed completion identity, legal separated tensor collision, or prior theorem with the same fixed-law source-minimal fiber and conclusion stops the run. STRONGEST-FORM DRAFT (unverified, gaps listed inside): <repo-root>/internal/presolve_drafts/eid_sourcemin_cyclic_effect_rankfrontier.md
proposed_from.novelty_justification: The precise advance is a necessary-and-sufficient formula for the effect image of every source-minimal cyclic completion of one fixed normalized overcomplete-ICA representation, with an exact same-law completion for every retained ratio, two countermodels under nonidentification, and polynomial-time certification. The iid layer adds simultaneous uniform coverage and root-N Hausdorff uncertainty for the resulting finite causal set, rather than merely recovering mixing columns.

proposed_from.literature_map: The literature scan through September 5, 2026 separates four objects. First, DaiAlbrechtSpirtesZhang2026 characterizes equality of graph-indexed distribution families using children bases, edge ranks, perfect matchings, and graph moves; its Hong Kong appendix reports \(1{,}331\) daily observations, fourteen stocks, two latent variables, and \(19{,}008\) compatible graphs. Second, TramontanoKivvaSalehkaleybarDrtonKiyavash2024 gives complete generic direct- and total-effect criteria for acyclic latent LiNGAM, while TramontanoDrtonEtesami2026 gives only partial cyclic coefficient criteria for known mixed graphs and records reciprocal-cycle ambiguity. Third, LacerdaSpirtesRamseyHoyer2008 enumerates square cyclic ICA-compatible SEMs and shows that stability can sometimes prune them; BongersForrePetersMooij2021 requires separate observational and interventional solvability. Fourth, WangSeigal2026 gives an if-and-only-if OICA identifiability condition and coupled recovery, while AnandkumarGeJanzamin2015, ChenBickel2006, PodosinnikovaEtAl2019, and VirtaNordhausenOja2016 provide perturbation, efficient-ICA, generating-function, and multi-cumulant ingredients. SchkodaRobevaDrton2024 remains acyclic, and DrtonEtAl2025 remains fully observed. No closer paper found in theorem text subsumes the fixed-numerical-law source-minimal cyclic effect image, the latent-row-shear converse, or simultaneous rank-selected effect-set coverage.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorem 1: sharp effect frontier
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The frontier is conditional on a fixed normalized OICA representation and on source-minimal monomial disturbance assignment; it is not claimed invariant to source splitting, duplicated sources, or alternative normalized representations of the same observed law.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Sharp over the stated fiber \(\mathfrak F_x(C,\varepsilon)\), conditional on the fixed representation \((C,\varepsilon)\).

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorem 3: uniform confidence frontier
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The finite-sample statement is conditional on the nonempty separated common-order OICA class and iid sampling; it does not cover the Hong Kong time series or source-specific cumulant orders.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Uniform \(1-\alpha\) coverage and root-\(N\) informative-regime radius only over \(\mathfrak P_{p,n,r}(a,\delta,\sigma,\kappa,\Lambda,M)\).
